_comment_about_this_template: Per-user Claude Code settings template. Drop into .claude/settings.local.json in your repo and customize for YOUR machine. This file is gitignored - do not commit it. Add '.claude/settings.local.json' to your .gitignore.
_comment_relationship_to_settings_json: settings.local.json overrides .claude/settings.json. Use it for: machine-specific paths, personal permission preferences, locally-enabled MCP servers. The PR review experience improves when settings.json contains only project-wide invariants and settings.local.json holds your personal additions.

permissions._comment: Add commands you've deemed safe to run without prompting. Be conservative - allowed commands run without your review. Examples below; uncomment what you trust.

enabledMcpjsonServers._comment_about_mcp_servers: List MCP server names from .mcp.json that you want enabled in this project. Empty list = all enabled.
